newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NK PROPERTIES TO BECOME CMC UNIT.
newsitem.headline: NK PROPERTIES TO BECOME CMC UNIT.

text.p: NK Properties Ltd said on Tuesday that shareholders had approved a scheme of arrangement in terms of which Consolidated Mining Corp Ltd (CMC) would become its wholly-owned subsidiary.
The arrangement was also agreed to by CMC shareholders at a similar shareholder meeting last Friday.
NK Properties shareholders had also approved:
- the change of NKP's name to Consolidated African Mines Ltd with effect from August 25; and
- the ratification of a number of direct and indirect ordinary shareholdings in Saflife Ltd, JCI Ltd, Randgold & Exploration Co Ltd and Witnigel Investments Ltd.
As a result of the arrangement, CMC's listing was expected to be terminated on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange from August 22.
